title: Crows, animals, sprinklers and robots all sense through the wall between the farm and the house interior
tier_reason: Latent today and load-bearing the moment any second interior exists: P-18's whole analysis rests on the sim not believing in one global metric, and seven measurements currently do.
ask:
The world is one SimWorld whose rows are stacked in 20-row pages (page 0 the farm, page 1 the home interior), and every radius in the game measures on raw grid coordinates with no idea that a page boundary exists.

Unguarded today, audited 2026-09-14:
  - sim_world.gd is_protected_by_scarecrow (+/-4 tile raw scan)
  - entities/crow.gd _player_is_near (pixel distance between two Node2Ds)
  - species_defs.gd crop_sense 5.0 on both grazer rows
  - sim_world.gd nearest()
  - sim/scent.gd deposit_blob radius
  - sprinkler_brain.gd radius, bot_brain.gd shoo radius and follow distance

All seven are correct only by coincidence of layout: the home's floor begins six rows below the farm's last row and the largest radius in the game is four. Nothing enforces that gap. crow_brain.gd _off_the_map is the one measurement that was taught about pages, by hand, on 2026-09-06 -- this is that same bug, found once and fixed in one place.

Add SimWorld.space_of(tile), derived from the grid the way is_parcel_open and is_coop_tile are (kept nowhere, saved never), and guard each measurement above with it: a measurement between two tiles in different spaces has no answer. Not a large number -- no answer. See docs/design/15-interiors.md section 5 and DECISION_LOG P-18 consequence 1.

Sim-only, layer 2, no verb, no new state, nothing a replay can see. Ships with unit tests that plant an actor on each page and prove no sense reaches across.
first_action: Write SimWorld.space_of(tile) and a failing unit test that stands a scarecrow on the farm's bottom row and a crow on the home page's top row, then guard the seven measurements listed in the ask.
source_message: Audited while answering the CEO's interiors directive, 2026-09-14.
result: Added SimWorld.space_of(tile) as a derived lookup for the farm, home, and each placed room; it adds no saved state. Scarecrow scans, crow proximity, crop senses, nearest frightener, scent blobs, sprinkler coverage, and shoo/follow robot distances now stop at a storage-space boundary. The Spiral Tower keeps its half-pitch world-position mapping while its room cells have a distinct sensing space. A new regression test first failed with a scarecrow on the farm bottom row protecting the home top row; the completed tests cover the other senses and the scene-level crow. Unit: 2,971 passed; integration: 1,012 passed; robot replay, demo replay regeneration, gateway self-test and check, benchmark, and writing verification passed. GitHub Actions completed successfully for f50eb7eb04862d4f9345ce0f020463a3d893b8f8.

landed.note: Verified sensing guards and focused replay/gateway checks; GitHub Actions passed.
